statics.言わないことも、言葉のうち。: What you leave unsaid is still said.
statics.手のひらで、相手の胸を。: The flat of your hand, against their chest.
statics.ポケットの中身は、持ち主の記憶でもある。: What's in a pocket is the owner's memory, too.
statics.値段のつく話は早い。: Talk with a price on it goes fast.
statics.次の一手のために、いまを書いておく。: Write down the now, for the next move.
statics.声を大きくすれば、相手は小さくなる。たいていは。: Raise your voice and they get smaller. Usually.
statics.同じ夜を、何度でも。: The same night, again and again.
statics.呼べば、誰かが来る。来なくても。: Call, and someone comes. Even when no one does.
statics.暗がりは、いつも一歩先にある。: The dark is always one step ahead.
statics.本当の約束。だから、破ると重い。: A real promise. So it weighs more when broken.
statics.残しておきたくないものもある。: Some things you don't want left behind.
statics.同じ手を、もう一度。今度は自分の手で。: The same move, once more. Your own hand this time.
statics.答えより、答えるまでの間を聞く。: Listen less to the answer than to the pause before it.
statics.聞いている、と伝えるだけでいい。: Just let them know you're listening.
statics.壁は、たいてい味方だ。: Walls are usually on your side.
statics.火をつけるあいだは、誰も急かさない。: While you light up, no one rushes you.
statics.同じ瓶から注げば、話は早い。: Pour from the same bottle and talk comes easy.
statics.笑わせるのは、斬るより難しい。: Making them laugh is harder than cutting them.
statics.役人だけは、褒められると疑う。: Only officials grow suspicious when praised.
statics.怒っている相手ほど、脅しはよく効く。: The angrier they are, the better a threat works.
statics.紙幣は、いちばん口の軽い紙だ。: Banknotes are the loosest-lipped paper there is.
statics.夜が深いほど、時計は役に立つ。: The deeper the night, the more a clock is worth.
statics.当たらなければ、傷にもならない。: If it doesn't land, it doesn't wound.
statics.床は、誰にでも等しく硬い。: The floor is equally hard for everyone.
statics.見つけたら、明かりをつけて。: When you find it, turn on the light.
statics.残すことは、奪うことに似ている。: Keeping a thing is a lot like taking it.
statics.テープは、言い直しを許さない。: Tape doesn't allow a second take.
statics.真夜中に出てくれる番号が、ひとつだけある。: One number still picks up at midnight.
statics.第何条かは、言わなくていい。: No need to say which article.
statics.見たことを、見たとおりに。それがいちばん難しい。: What you saw, as you saw it. That's the hardest part.
statics.秘密は、手放した分だけ軽くなる。: A secret gets lighter by however much you let go.
statics.覚えていないことにする。今夜だけ。: Decide you don't remember. Just for tonight.
statics.ポケットの中で、角が丸くなった。: Its corners wore round in your pocket.
statics.題名を思い出せない歌。: A song whose title you can't recall.
statics.床が見えると、考えも見える。: When you can see the floor, you can see your thoughts.
statics.三回。間をあけて、もう二回。: Three times. A pause, then two more.
statics.間合いは、退いて作る。: You make distance by backing off.
statics.手は出さない、と言いながら。: All while saying you won't lay a hand on them.
statics.合わない数は、嘘の居場所だ。: A number that doesn't add up is where a lie lives.
statics.同じ角を、三度曲がる。: The same corner, turned three times.
statics.ライターと、話の続きを。: A lighter, for the rest of the story.
statics.包み紙の分だけ、気持ちが伝わる。: The wrapping says as much as the gift.
statics.包帯を巻く手が、止まらない。: The hands winding the bandage won't stop.
statics.流用：溢れた回復 ×0.8 が相手の体力を削る: Spill: overflow healing ×0.8 damages their body
statics.動かない人間は、いずれ景色になる。: A person who doesn't move becomes scenery, eventually.
statics.流用：手番の終わりに残った守りの 1/3 が信頼になる: Spill: 1/3 of guard left at turn's end becomes trust
statics.多すぎる心付けは、侮辱になる。: Too big a tip is an insult.
statics.流用：遭遇で払った金の半分が、相手の意志を折る: Spill: half the coins you pay in an encounter break their will
statics.誰も確かめない話ほど、よく回る。: The less a story gets checked, the farther it travels.
statics.流用：嘘で得た信頼と同じだけ、相手の意志を削る: Spill: trust gained by lying wears down their will by as much
statics.開けられるが、開けない。: You could open it. You don't.
statics.流用：去る率が 100% を超えた 10% ごとに、毎手番 相手の守り −1: Spill: for every 10% of walk-away odds past 100%, their guard −1 each turn
statics.殴られているうちに、相手のほうが疲れてくる。: Take enough hits and they tire first.
statics.流用：守りで受け止めた傷の半分だけ、相手の意志が折れる: Spill: half the damage your guard absorbs breaks their will
statics.測るように見ていたはずが、いつのまにか。: You meant to watch them the way you'd measure. Somewhere, that changed.
statics.流用：本当の予告を見るたび、信頼 +2: Spill: trust +2 each time you see a true tell
statics.0 回で使うと信頼 +1（差し出すことで信じてもらう）: Trust +1 when used at 0 uses (you give, so they believe you)
statics.予告が嘘でも見える: See their tell, even when it's a lie
statics.遭遇の初めに手がかりを 1 つ: 1 clue at the start of each encounter
statics.手がかりを見るたび、相手の意志 −2: Each time you see a clue: their will −2
statics.3 枚目ごとのカードは回数を減らさない: Every third card costs no use
statics.嘘がばれると、かえって信頼 +3（憎めない）: Caught lying: trust +3 instead (hard to hate)
statics.真似るが元より強い（×1.3）: Mimic hits harder than the original (×1.3)
statics.体力を削る量 ×1.3。ただし初めの敵意 +2: Body damage dealt ×1.3, but starting hostility +2
statics.予告が見え、嘘の予告の手番はカード ×1.3: See their tell; on false-tell turns, cards ×1.3
statics.遭遇の初め、相手は 1 手番うごけない: At the start of each encounter, they can't act for 1 turn
statics.相手の体力が半分を切ると、体力を削る量 ×1.3: Their body below half: body damage dealt ×1.3
statics.立ち去れない。そのかわり毎手番 守り +3・心の構え +2: You can't walk away. Instead, +3 guard · +2 calm each turn
statics.信頼が半ばを越えた相手へのカード ×1.5（裏切り）: Cards ×1.5 against those whose trust is past halfway (betrayal)
statics.信頼を得た相手を倒すと、金 20 と全カード +1: Defeat someone who trusted you: 20 coins and all cards +1 use
statics.裏切って倒すと 金 20・全カード +1: Betray and defeat: 20 coins · all cards +1
statics.打ち解けると、体力と精神が全快: Win them over: body and mind fully restored
statics.一撃で受ける傷は、いまの体力の半分まで: No single hit takes more than half your current body
statics.敵意 6 以上の相手の意志を削る量 ×1.4: Will damage dealt to foes at hostility 6+ ×1.4
statics.体力を削るたび、意志も半分だけ削る: Whenever you damage body, will takes half as much
statics.［記憶］のカードを使うと、話がそれて手がかりがもう 1 つ。新しい場所に着くたび: Playing a [Memory] card sends the talk sideways: one more clue. Each time you reach a new place, [Memory] cards +1 use.
statics.守りが手番をまたいで全部残る。カードの体力の代償を受けない。体力を削る量 +2。: All guard carries over between turns. Cards' body costs don't apply. Body damage dealt +2.
statics.深夜、嘘の予告がすべて見える。相手は初めから信頼 +1。毎手番 心の構え +2。: Late at night, every false tell shows. They start with trust +1. +2 calm each turn.
statics.［聖人］と［門番］（バルジャンとジャベール）。体力が 3 割を切った相手への信頼: [Saint] and [Gatekeeper] (Valjean and Javert). Trust +3 toward those below 30% body (mercy). Relying on others puts you in no one's debt. [Person] foes start with trust +1.
statics.遭遇で最初に使うカードは回数を減らさない。［私的情報］の手がかりを見るたび金 8: The first card you play in an encounter costs no use. Each [Private] clue you see: 8 coins. At the start of each encounter, their defense −2.
statics.予告はいつも本当の姿で見える。［制度］の相手の意志を 1.5 倍削る。ただし信頼: Tells always show their true form. Will damage vs. [Institution] ×1.5. But trust gain −1.
statics.［漂流者］と［門番］（案内人）。かならず立ち去れる。手がかりを見るたび金 4（ゾ: [Drifter] and [Gatekeeper] (the guide). You can always walk away. Each clue you see: 4 coins (goods from the Zone).
statics.誤った手がかりが混じらない。本当の手がかりを見るたび、相手の意志を 2 削る。: No false clues mix in. Each true clue you see: their will −2.
statics.予告はいつも本当の姿で見える。見抜かれた嘘を打った相手は、意志を 5 失う。: Tells always show their true form. A foe whose lie you see through loses 5 will.
statics.4 手番目から体力を削る量 ×1.5。5 手番目からはかならず去れる。: From turn 4: body damage dealt ×1.5. From turn 5: you can always walk away.
statics.予告が見える。意志を削る量 +1。: You see their tell. Will damage dealt +1.
statics.相手を動けなくするたび、敵意 −2。: Each time you stop them from acting: hostility −2.
statics.打ち解けるか暴くと、［記憶］のカードの回数 +1。: When you win them over or expose them: [Memory] cards +1 use.
statics.遭遇の初めに手がかりを 1 つ。: 1 clue at the start of each encounter.
